scope: Síntesis narrativa breve para los cuatro documentos generales y los artículos I–IV.
word_count_policy: Cada ficha contiene entre 100 y 150 palabras; los recuentos se verifican por separación de espacios.

generales.title: El cierre holográfico del infinito
generales.subtitle: La estructura discreta del continuo y el origen de las constantes fundamentales
generales.text: The comprehensive corpus develops the foundations of Triadic Modular Holography and Dimensional Mechanics: the discrete constitution of the continuum links number, geometry, and physical quantity. Starting from APP–TRIT–TPK and the joint construction of the numerical and exceptional projections, it develops the constants, the structure of the electron, the mass operators, and the realizations of action, gravity, and information. Definitions, theorems, examples, and verification procedures allow the dependencies between results to be reconstructed. It preserves the elementary constructions and their specialized developments, including cardinal closure within holographic closure. It is the technical reference for studying how a common genealogy transmits structure between results, within the domain specified for each claim.

generales.title: Holografía Modular Triádica
generales.subtitle: Exposición sistemática del núcleo formal, sus extensiones y derivaciones
generales.text: The treatise systematically sets out the operations of the formal core, its extensions, and its derivations. It starts from the initial grid and develops compatible prolongation, double projection, and the correlated generation of constants. The selection of the coupling record, its recovery, exceptional incidence, and the laws of information conservation receive explicit treatment. Dimensional Mechanics extends these foundations towards action, area, physical constants, and material organization. The exposition shows what each transformation determines, what it preserves, and what it allows to be reconstructed; the proofs specify their conditions. The intermediate steps, developed in detail, make the transmission of structure from elementary operations to subsequent realizations intelligible.

generales.title: El cierre holográfico del infinito
generales.subtitle: La estructura discreta del continuo y el origen de las constantes fundamentales
generales.text: The narrative exposition develops the meaning of a construction that links mathematical explanation, measurement, and physical constitution. It asks what determines a constant, what distinguishes a particle, and what relations an organization preserves as it transforms. The historical and philosophical background leads to APP–TRIT–TPK, the continuum, the constants, the electron, and the organization of masses. Exceptional incidence, area, and information reveal connections across these topics. The narrative places each result within the common argument and explains what knowledge it contributes: how generative relations determine properties and make them intelligible. This epistemological and ontological approach offers complementary access to the technical documents containing the corresponding constructions and proofs.

generales.title: Doble proyección holográfica de un cristal temporal aperiódico
generales.subtitle: Construcción del continuo como límite inverso de cilindros compatibles, generación coinductiva de π, φ, e, α y estabilizadores excepcionales de la incidencia fronteriza
generales.text: The monograph develops the double projection of the continuum from an arithmetic of oriented configurations. Refinements preserve the preceding levels while increasing resolution, height, and memory; their compatible sequences form an inverse limit. The aperiodic time crystal expresses the coexistence of local phase returns with an ongoing global evolution. On this support, π, φ, e, and α are generated, the electronic section is constructed, and action, area, and information are linked. The conjugate projection preserves the incidences that lead to exceptional realizations. Numerical determination and temporal order are thus linked to the same structure that preserves the geometric relations of the continuum.

articulos_I_IV.title: Generación coinductiva de π, φ y e a profundidad arbitraria, derivación de α y la estructura algebraica del electrón
articulos_I_IV.text: The generation of π, φ, and e proceeds from distinct operations of the APP–TRIT–TPK core: angular, modal, and propagation readings of the same arithmetic construction. The coordinates are prolonged through ternary blocks and compatible cylinders, determining prefixes to arbitrary depth. Dodecaphase closure with carry determines α from the generated sequences. The development preserves the link between record selection, numerical reading, and exceptional incidence. In the electron, local projectors produce an explicit incompatibility norm; torsional normalization and return action lead to the profile (80, 54, 6) and its mass evaluation. Arithmetic generation, action, and the structure of a particle are linked by operations that transmit their dependencies.

articulos_I_IV.title: Origen estructural del parámetro de Barbero–Immirzi y de los ángulos de mezcla CKM; derivación de las constantes de Planck, Boltzmann y gravitación universal
articulos_I_IV.subtitle: Relación entre acción, área, información y entropía de entrelazamiento
articulos_I_IV.text: Action, area, and information are linked through operations that preserve the orientation of incidence. The sections before and after the return are related by a defined action ratio. The transition from hexad to octad determines sectors of 90 and 120 configurations and enters the expression for the Barbero–Immirzi parameter, linking sectorial composition and entanglement entropy. The sectorial sextet produces an invertible rational matrix that determines the CKM mixing angles and allows the initial coordinates to be recovered; the CP phase retains its angular dependence. Boltzmann’s constant relates decision energy, the thermal section, and tritic information normalization. Gravitation acts as the reciprocal section of action: their product preserves an areal scale.

articulos_I_IV.title: Estructura constitutiva del vacío y propagación electromagnética
articulos_I_IV.subtitle: Derivación de la constante de Catalán, la permeabilidad y la permitividad
articulos_I_IV.text: The electromagnetic response is constructed through two oriented channels of the same transport. The incidences 90 and 120 determine an operator whose eigenvalues produce the constitutive coordinates of permittivity and permeability; impedance and propagation speed are obtained from them. Cubic inversion recovers the initial channels. The double moment of the resolvent associated with the transport generates Catalan’s constant; the Pell specialization establishes an exact identity between that moment and two reciprocal factors. The dimensional realization then allows charge, von Klitzing resistance, conductance, magnetic flux, and the Josephson constant to be derived. Their common identities make explicit the relations preserved in passing from the internal construction to measurable quantities.

articulos_I_IV.title: Extensión de la estructura discreta del continuo: álgebras de operadores de vértice, Moonshine, dualidad T y teoría M
articulos_I_IV.text: The prolongation of the core towards exceptional realizations preserves marked incidence and the memory of routes. The complete census distinguishes oriented conditions, emissions, and ternary images, preserving their multiplicities. A Witt flag determines a self-dual ternary code; its gluing leads to a Niemeier lattice and to an even, unimodular, rootless neighbour identified as the Leech lattice. On this lattice, the vertex operator construction reaches the Moonshine module, whose graded character is j − 744 and whose automorphism group is the Monster. The nonadic tower yields the operator continuum. T-duality, dimensional screens, and the dynamical realization of M-theory are articulated through maps and domains that preserve the provenance of the initial record.
